reviews.text: From the moment I called Heights Grooming I felt 100% comfortable sending my Golden Retriever for her first professional cut. The owner was so friendly and professional, and I was able to speak with the groomer before and after the grooming, which was so reassuring. They were communicative the entire time and even made sure to compliment my dog’s smile, showing just how involved they were in her grooming. They squeezed us in last minute, and my dog left looking amazing and happy, plus she got a cute toy to take home! I’ll definitely be back!

We’ve been bringing our doodle to Heights Pet Grooming for over three years, and we couldn’t be happier. Jose is absolutely wonderful with her—she gets so excited every time it’s spa day! It’s clear he genuinely cares about the dogs and takes the time to make them feel comfortable and loved.

She always comes home looking beautiful, happy, and relaxed. The staff is friendly, professional, and consistently provides excellent service. We highly recommend Heights Pet Grooming, especially Jose, to anyone looking for a groomer who truly treats your pet like family.

I want to start off by saying this place has great customer service. But unfortunately that’s all they have. I have a long-haired dapple dachshund they don’t actually do grooming and styling. All they do is take a guard and run it along their body so if you want to keep your dogs coat long and just thin out their hair to keep the design they can’t do that. Also, you can tell his cut was rushed. There were still long pieces of hair along his back if you’re looking for a place just to just run a guard and shave your dog down then this place is for you but if you have any type of long-haired dog and you’re not looking to shave down their coat, and actually have some styling probably best to look another place.

Jimmy is exceptional and has been grooming our dog for years. We followed him to Heights Grooming and have been very impressed with their team of people, their care of the animals and their professionalism. They make it convenient to book, sign in, drop off/pickup, and pay, which we greatly appreciate. Jimmy knows it can be a nerve wrecking experience for some dogs (ours included!) so his sensitivity and skills are much appreciated!

I have been taking my Cocker Spaniel–Poodle mix, Winston, to Heights Grooming since I moved to Houston in December. Because he is part doodle, he needs frequent grooming, so we go about once a month.

Heights Grooming always does a wonderful job! They always take the time to ask exactly what style I want, keep their pricing transparent and reasonable, and make sure Winston is comfortable and calm. He is always so excited to go to the groomer and comes out looking amazing every time! They are also incredibly flexible and provide great customer service. There have been several times when I’ve asked to be squeezed in last minute or early in the morning, and they always do their best to accommodate me. I highly recommend them!

Great place. Eddie the owner is super nice and easy to schedule with. He is flexible if your grooming time/date changes. Jose has been grooming my dog for a year and he’s done a great job. Amazing location and fair prices. Clean facility. Highly recommend!!!
They did an amazing job on Luke! We are both very happy 😊 this is our second time coming and the experience is amazing, staff is very warm and welcoming!💚

10 STARS IF I COULD!!!

I conducted extensive research to find the perfect grooming salon for my Cavapoo puppy, as I want to build a trusting, long-term relationship for her regular grooming needs. From the moment I first visited Heights Pet Grooming, I knew I had found the right place. The owner, Eddie, and his entire team were incredibly gracious and kind. Eddie's commitment to building a top-tier, relationship-oriented business is evident in every detail.

I can't believe I found a place that meets all my wants and needs! The salon is locally owned, easy to access, has its own building with parking, and most importantly, is staffed by truly talented groomers. It's a very sweet place with cute decor, flowers, and thoughtful design.

I picked Zoe up from her first "Puppy Trim" and she was not only gorgeous but also so happy! Brenda did a beautiful job! I am beyond thrilled to have found a grooming salon where I can take my little fur baby with complete confidence and peace of mind. Five stars, without a doubt!

I cannot recommend this place enough! There was a slight misunderstanding regarding a promotion that actually wasn't through his company, but the owner honored it anyway without hesitation. It’s rare to find that level of integrity and top-tier customer service these days. On top of that, my dog looks absolutely amazing—the quality of the work is just as impressive as the professionalism. On top of that the groomer was the icing on the cake really amazing and did a great job! If you’re looking for a groomer who truly cares, this is the spot!"

They always do an excellent job! My dog always comes home looking amazing, smelling fresh, and happy. They are professional, caring, and pay attention to every detail. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a great groomer! special thanks to Ms Brenda

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Hands down the BEST groomers in Houston! I can’t say enough about how impressed I am with their service. They don’t just do a great job grooming—they truly care about your pet and treat them like family.

Brenda did an amazing job on my doodle today. I’m very careful about who I trust with my dog, and Eddie has completely earned that trust. He went above and beyond today, staying over an hour and a half after closing so I could pick up my pup after work. That kind of kindness and dedication is rare, and it really shows how much they care about both the pets and their owners.

So, we’re new clients and had never been to this groomer before. We used to live in the Austin area and took our pup to Barkin Creek and they were always so great that when we moved to Houston, we didn’t know where to go. I’m a member of a Facebook group for my dog’s breed, and this place was recommended, along with Eddie, the owner. It was also the closest groomer to me, so I was really hopeful it would become our go-to spot.

The front desk staff and everyone who answered the phone were so kind and amazing. They make you feel like you’re in great hands. However, one thing to keep in mind is that the front desk staff may not be the person grooming your dog. With that said, I was nervous but still wanted to give them a try.

When we arrived, we were greeted with a smile by a staff member who I believe was Jessica. But as soon as I met the groomer, I didn’t get a great vibe. He wasn’t very friendly…civil, but not welcoming and it felt like he didn’t want to be there. Then once we when we received a call stating that for wee was ready, her ears weren’t done the eciated. But when I confirmed that we did want her ears pointy, he insisted they wouldn’t stand up because the photo I showed wasn’t of my dog. I understood that, but we then had to wait while he shaved her ears, even though we’d already been told she was ready. Her ears *did* stand up like I wanted. we’ve had them done that way before so it was frustrating to be argued with, especially since I had mentioned this multiple times beforehand.
While her body was trimmed, her tail wasn’t. Her face wasn’t properly rounded, and the cuts looked rushed and uneven. Her paws weren’t shaved or cleaned, and her sanitary area wasn’t addressed at all. We paid for the full service, and I’m glad my husband didn’t tip much even before seeing the final result on the TV cx because it wasn’t worth it.
She was bathed, and her nails were trimmed, but overall, the grooming quality was very disappointing. We won’t be coming back. If you’re looking for a well-done, clean, and thorough grooming, this isn’t the place. There may be better groomers out there, but this experience caused us to lose trust, and I don’t feel comfortable booking another service here. It’s especially disappointing because we really wanted to like this place and support a local business, but it just wasn’t a good experience for us at all.

Good experience ,welcoming , convenience grooming place.  Affordable compared to some other places.
We take our family dogs and my dogs for full service or nail clip/grind. Recommended

Mary Lou and Eddie are such sweethearts and so professional at the same time. I feel 100% comfortable leaving my fur baby with them after I had a terrible experience at another groomers  a few months back. Mary Lou made my baby look so cute and so handsome And it was quick as well. Thank you guys for taking care of Esco!!

I've been taking my mini schnauzer here for ~1-2 years. They always do a great job and I give them very little instruction. It's taken me about 3 years to find a place in Texas and I'm glad I finally found these guys v

Thank you Eddie and Heights Pet Grooming for helping me transform Mattie who was living in an abandoned apartment complex for 3 months at no charge! I take my Bichon Mello to Eddie regularly so I was already a fan of their work! Thanks for the kind gesture and having a big heart. Some things are more important than money as you have shown! She's a new dog now!

Can't say enough great things about the staff here!! After trying mobile groomers and other grooming places, Snowball and I finally have a groomer we can trust! Ms. Brenda takes such good care of him and you can tell they really care about their clientele! This is our third time coming to Heights Pet Groomer since the new owners took over and we love it!

I brought Briggs to Heights Pet Grooming for the first time today, and I couldn't be more impressed! Jose did a phenomenal job--there were no lines in his cut, his feet look amazing, and his little mohawk is absolutely perfect. He even cleaned the inside of Briggs' ears and trimmed the hair short to help prevent infections, which are common in Cocker Spaniels. We've been struggling with that for a couple of months now, so I really appreciated the extra care.

Eddie, the owner, was also incredibly helpful and made sure I felt completely comfortable leaving Briggs in their hands. The entire experience was smooth, friendly, and professional.

They have four full-time groomers and one part-time, and their prices are very reasonable--not inflated like so many other places in the area.

Thank you, Jose, for making Briggs look and feel amazing! He's ready to take on this warm weather in style, and I'm so happy we found such a great groomer right down the street from Three Dog Bakery in the Heights.

We decided to give this place another chance after changing ownership, and I’m so glad we did! My initial phone call with the owner was pleasant and he was able to squeeze us in day-of. Both the owner and groomer took time to listen to my requests for our elderly dog. They minimized her crate time, gave her a fabulous cut and were efficient and communicative. Their prices are comparable to other groomers in the area which was great to see. This along with the customer service and convenience in location will have us coming back to this great local spot for our girl

I’ve bounced from grooming place to grooming place as they underwhelmed, groomers left, or they shut down.

I saw the reviews for the old owners and was hesitant to trust them with my doodle.

The new owners are lovely. They clearly care about the business and have hired groomers that are both talented and care about the dogs they groom.

Most of the bad reviews come from the old owners (and to be clear, I don’t know the new  owners)

I am overly careful about who grooms my dog. They’ve exceeded my expectations. They also do very cute doodle cuts.
